## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the change and its user-visible result.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their outcome, and anything unverified. Include the
relevant synthetic reproduction, docs update or migration/recovery check.

## Review notes

Call out permission, dependency, license, security, compatibility or data changes.
Disclose AI assistance and verify its output. Identify any third-party material
and its notices. Do not include credentials, private source or operator receipts.
